description: Match the tools advertised by a Playground MCP server to operational guidance in this distribution. A terminal * matches a tool-name prefix. Availability depends on the selected workspace, installed providers and host settings.

capabilities.title: Discover canonical skills, resources, task prompts and provider routes
Choose, open, attach, persist and manage browser or native desktop workspaces
Discover releases and deployment forms, capture configuration, share recipes and launch sites
Navigate, inspect and operate the site, Playground, development panels and desktop webviews
Discover and call Joomla Web Services via the maintained TypeScript provider
Discover and call site-installed Joomla, JCB and generated extension operations
Connect to a configured external Joomla site through the Composer stdio client
Inspect provider capabilities, read its resources and templates, and use its prompts
Author models and reusable entities, compile, install and test generated extensions
Search, edit, import, recover and manage files in JoomEngine Code
Inspect the live MariaDB database and verify application state
Debug PHP on real requests and inspect paused execution
Inspect and manage messages captured by the Playground mail catcher
Inspect browser storage and recover persisted workspaces
Save, update, export, import, restore and remove site backups
Transfer installers and portable exports between the workspace, MCP client and host files
Start long-running tasks and inspect progress and results
